summary.intent: Run the GSD discuss-phase workflow for phase 68.2 (cipher-box) to surface remaining architectural gray areas around consolidating the IPNS/IPFS read chain into the SDK, and produce a locked-decisions CONTEXT.md for downstream researcher/planner agents.
summary.outcome: Produced and committed 68.2-CONTEXT.md and 68.2-DISCUSSION-LOG.md capturing four locked decisions: SDK exposes listFolder()/listShareFolder() returning ResolvedChild[] with a folder:updated event; freshness via re-resolve-on-open plus poll-driven invalidation; big-bang cutover gated on green web-e2e with the ba3e0229a mirror reverted last; and both read AND write paths (expanded from read-only per user) must go through @cipherbox/sdk with no runtime sdk-core/core/raw IPFS-IPNS calls from apps/web (type-only imports excepted), reusing the existing RotationHighWater/HighWaterStore as the DurableFloorStore with an injectable mock for Node SDK tests.

repo: packages/sdk already has the anti-rollback seam the roadmap called for: RotationHighWater + IndexedDB-backed HighWaterStore, injected into client.ts — no new DurableFloorStore abstraction needed.
The web read path currently runs a duplicate ROT-07 gate in ipns.service.ts::resolveRecord, separate from the SDK's gate — this duplication is what phase 68.2 collapses.

useSharedNavigationActions.ts imports navigateReadChain/resolveIpnsRecord directly from @cipherbox/sdk-core and unsealNode/unsealChildReadKey from @cipherbox/core, bypassing the SDK facade; kind-cache.ts also calls raw resolve directly.

54 web files import @cipherbox/core and 15 import @cipherbox/sdk-core, but most @cipherbox/core imports are type-only (Node, SealedChildRef, ResolvedChild) — the facade boundary should forbid runtime calls, not type imports, to avoid 54-file no-op churn.
client-rotation.test.ts already has a fakeRotationHighWater pattern for mocking HighWaterStore in Node SDK unit tests — reuse this pattern for 68.2's injected/mockable HighWaterStore.

code.finding: RotationHighWater implementation — the existing durable anti-rollback gate (owns enforceResolved) to be reused as the phase's DurableFloorStore seam.

Todo-to-phase matching in GSD is coarse keyword-overlap scoring (69 todos matched, only 4 truly in-scope) — treat matched-todo counts as a rough filter, not a precise signal.

friction: Todo-matching scoring is coarse (keyword overlap), surfacing 69 candidate todos when only 4 were actually in-scope for the phase's success criteria.

The roadmap's literal SC#1 wording (naming only unsealNode/unsealChildReadKey/web-side resolveIpnsRecord) undershot the user's actual intended boundary, requiring a follow-up clarification round to correctly scope the facade enforcement (read-only vs read+write, type-only imports vs runtime calls).
